title: AI Engineering & LLM Apps
description: Build reliable, production AI applications: LLM APIs, structured JSON outputs, tool calling, vector embeddings, RAG retrieval, streaming UX, evals, and safety guardrails.
outcomes: Integrate LLM APIs cleanly with system prompts, temperature control, and token budgets
Enforce type-safe JSON schemas and reliable function/tool calling
Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with chunking, embeddings, and citations
Measure quality systematically using automated eval suites, latency tracking, and prompt-injection defenses
